name: Fogo Foundation
rootCause: The Fogo Foundation experienced a compromise by an unknown actor, resulting in 400 million FOGO tokens being sent to a bad actor. The Foundation immediately alerted exchanges, law enforcement, and forensic experts. Initially stated no impact on the blockchain, but later halted the mainnet as a precaution to restrict associated addresses and prevent further asset movement. Mainnet was later restarted after recovering and permanently removing 237 million tokens.

descriptions.text: The Fogo Foundation experienced a compromise by an unknown actor, resulting in 400 million FOGO tokens being sent to a bad actor. The Foundation immediately alerted exchanges, law enforcement, and forensic experts. Initially stated no impact on the blockchain, but later halted the mainnet as a precaution to restrict associated addresses and prevent further asset movement. Mainnet was later restarted after recovering and permanently removing 237 million tokens.

On August 29, 2026, a wallet controlled by the Fogo Foundation was compromised, allowing an attacker to drain 400 million FOGO tokens,over 10% of circulating supply. The breach caused an 18% price crash and led to a mainnet halt. Forensic, technical, and on-chain specifics remain unreleased. Reported compromise of a privileged Foundation-controlled wallet: the attack most likely exploited weaknesses in private key management or access control, but the specific method and operational setup have not been disclosed by the Fogo Foundation.
